definitions.gloss: doctor in private practice; physician running their own clinic
definitions.explanation: A doctor who has opened and runs their own clinic, as opposed to one employed at a hospital ({勤務医|きんむい}). In Japan most local clinics ({医院|いいん}, クリニック) are run by such doctors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{開業医|かいぎょうい}だ。
examples.english: My father is a doctor in private practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開業医|かいぎょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{診|み}て→診る：09798_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I saw a local doctor at his clinic.

examples.japanese: {大学病院|だいがくびょういん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦{働|はたら}いた→働く：00503_hataraku⟧あと、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧{開業医|かいぎょうい}になった。
examples.english: After working at a university hospital for ten years, she went back to her hometown and opened her own practice.

notes:
⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧ (opening a business or practice) + {医|い} (doctor). To become one is ⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to open a practice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開業医|かいぎょうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to set up in private practice
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開業医|かいぎょうい}: local doctors in private practice
- {開業医|かいぎょうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介状|しょうかいじょう}→紹介状：23208_shoukaijou⟧: a referral letter from one's clinic doctor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勤務医|きんむい}: a doctor employed at a hospital
- ⟦かかりつけ{医|い}→かかりつけ医：22454_kakaritsukei⟧: one's regular family doctor, usually a {開業医|かいぎょうい}
